title: Money Off AND a Lowe's Gift Card? Yes, Please!
description: Yvonne explains a little bit about mortgages and what we have going on at the credit union until December 31st 2019!  Class Act Federal Credit Union Federally insured by NCUA Equal Housing Lender

asr.full_text: Good Morning this is Yvonne Overstreet and I am the Mortgage Lending Manager here at class act Federal Credit Union. And we are just coming in today with a quick little snippet about our current promotion in our real estate department. Currently we are offering $500 off of closing costs and a $250 gift card to Lowe's for any of our HELOCs and our second mortgages. So it's a great, great time if you're looking to do home improvements. If you're trying to do debt consolidation borrow against that equity. If you guys are in the market for a new property for home refinancing is big right now because the rates have dropped. So give us a call. We are calling this promotion about Let's Build This Together and that's because we really do want to help you build this together. We want to be there from step one all the way down to the very, very end and we're gonna help guide you any way that we need to and give you any help at any time. So, to apply you can do that are a time. To apply, you can go to classact.org. There is a tab at the top that says promotion. Click on that promotion and then down below is the let's build this together. And then you'll scroll down a little further and then it will have a little grid that shows you you can click for rates if you guys are just looking to get an idea where those are or you can say apply now and then it'll take you straight through the process, or you are welcome to text HOME H O M E to 5o 2212 3167 and then someone from our department will get back to you as soon as possible. We look forward to it! There's going to be some links in this post as well that might be some helpful information if you want to kind of search around for that give us a call we look forward to working with you and we'll come back our next post with a little bit more information about rates and some other good tips

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a conventional credit-union mortgage promotion in which a mortgage lending manager describes a closing-cost discount and Lowe’s gift card for HELOCs and second mortgages. Asking viewers to apply or contact the credit union through the stated website or text number is consistent with ordinary financial-product promotion, and the disclosure language and office-branded presentation provide additional benign context. The offer’s eligibility details, contact-channel authenticity, and whether applicants received the benefits are not independently established.
